hypotheses.rationale_with_citations: Both are daytime Capitol Hill residential burglaries on consecutive days, with entry through a rear slider or sliding door that was pried and left pry marks on the frame [CC-25-000158:narrative] [CC-25-000165:narrative]. In both, the master bedroom was ransacked and a safe was targeted, and the property taken was the same trio: cash, an Aldane K14 laptop and a cell phone [CC-25-000158:items] [CC-25-000165:items].

Both losses include a white Kestrel Ultra 16 laptop and a Sonique TV 55in [CC-25-000341:items] [CC-26-000485:items].
